name: Restaurant Business Intelligence System™
cta: Every month you wait is [another month of guessing.]
lines: hook
Friday night. A full dining room, a takeout rush, and a catering order for forty.
hook
Great night. But how much of that money did the restaurant actually [keep?]
hook
Food cost plus labor cost decides whether a restaurant survives. And most owners only ever look at sales.
hook
A dish can sell all night, and still leave almost nothing after food cost and labor.
hook
Spoilage, over-prep, portions that drift. It happens every shift, and almost never gets written down.
hook
If you run a restaurant, the next few minutes are for you.

pain

pain

pain

pain

pain
